answer: A workable design: randomly force a peer to replay your full reasoning chain and compare method. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The saffron of work and the kernel of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a hollow to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
